baseline.official_val_unseen_role: bounded development, checkpoint and method selection, all ablations and three-seed reporting; log every access; not a blind test
baseline.base_checkpoint_training_exposure: Official recipe uses full R2R train and augmentation; train_fit/train_dev only separate this project's adapter fitting and development
baseline.base_checkpoint_selection_exposure: Official R2R code selects best_val_unseen by validation-unseen SPL; exact author training logs are not available here
baseline.train_dev_role: adapter-held-out diagnostic and regression set; seen by the base-model training recipe, not unseen-environment evaluation

train_dev_completed_report.scope: seen adapter development; not an official val-unseen result

val_unseen_completed_report.scope: official unseen-scene validation development, not blind test

evaluation_protocol.access_logging: record each evaluation and new result-driven diagnostic analysis with purpose, config/checkpoint hashes, split and subset IDs, metrics, cost, and decision

evaluation_protocol.budget_revision_policy: document evidence and revised limits before additional variants; never erase previous accesses
evaluation_protocol.confirmatory_validation: freeze method and core ablation list, then report seeds 0/1/2 on full val_unseen under a separately recorded budget
evaluation_protocol.test_export_code_status: not yet implemented in the project wrapper
evaluation_protocol.test_submission_plan: after method freeze and concrete artifact review, consider one baseline and one method submission; default fixed seed 0; no test-driven seed selection
evaluation_protocol.test_unavailable_policy: report validation-development exposure and limits explicitly; do not relabel val_unseen as a blind test
evaluation_protocol.execution_sync_status: Training pipeline still selects train_dev; official val_unseen selection will use explicit registered accesses, not unbounded per-epoch evaluation.

primary_hypothesis: Different source observations of an unvisited candidate contain useful decision information lost by mean aggregation; arrival-based supervision provides an incremental, deployable benefit beyond source attention trained with navigation labels.
known_risks: Default DUET normally never repeats a decision source; repeated-source overcounting cannot be the main motivation.
Pano candidate features already contain panorama context and are not raw single-view visual descriptors.
Replacing a historical unvisited-node proxy with a future panorama may introduce an out-of-distribution perturbation.
Natural arrivals are selected by the baseline policy and are not an unbiased sample of all candidates.
Future-view auxiliary supervision already exists in prior work; a general future-supervision claim is insufficient.
The base checkpoint has seen R2R training scenes and was selected using val_unseen SPL; adapter-held-out train scenes are not base-unseen scenes.

stages.purpose: official full val_unseen development baseline after protocol and access-ledger setup
cross-scene read-only observer parity and replay identity
counterfactual replay and adapter-held-out scene probes; unseen transfer assessed separately on logged val_unseen development accesses
mean versus source-set aggregation crossed with absent versus present arrival supervision; only if diagnosis supports the hypothesis
full navigation development and matched controls
frozen method and ablations, three seeds on full val_unseen, transfer, possible reviewed blind-test submissions, paper materials

promotion_criteria: Confirm coverage on unmodified baseline trajectories with explicit denominators.
Show held-out information beyond scores and geometry; reject effects explained by shuffled targets or representation norm/orientation alone.
Show usefulness of currently observable source features or cross-fitted predicted auxiliary labels.
Beat matched source-attention and mean-with-arrival controls in full navigation without material SPL degradation.
Require reproducibility across seeds and a second benchmark or backbone before claiming the paper-sized study complete.
diagnosis_stop_conditions: Do not use repeated-source overcounting as the main hypothesis; retain its count only as a data-integrity diagnostic under the default protocol.
Stop or revise if multi-source coverage is too sparse to account for navigation errors.
If held-out gains disappear under geometry, shuffled-arrival, or norm controls, do not promote the auxiliary target as reliability supervision.
If evidence remains inconclusive, allow one documented sample expansion before choosing a new hypothesis.
parallel_alternative_audit: One pre-registered CPU stopping opportunity table from existing D1 training-scene states; configs/stopping_diagnostic.json; no model fitting or new official-validation access.
next_hypothesis: Stopping opportunity and comparable history scoring: diagnosis only; novelty not established.
